entries.title: Galatians 1:1
segments: Paul, an apostle sent not from men nor by any man, but by Jesus Christ and by God the Father who raised him from the dead;

entries.title: Galatians 1:2
segments: with all the brothers who are with me: To the churches of Galatia greeting.

entries.title: Galatians 1:3
segments: Grace be to you, and peace from God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ,

entries.title: Galatians 1:4
segments: who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us from this present evil age in accordance with the will of our God and Father,

entries.title: Galatians 1:5
segments: to whom be glory forever and ever. Amen.

entries.title: Galatians 1:6
segments: I am amazed that you are so soon shifting your ground, and deserting him who called you by the grace of Christ,

entries.title: Galatians 1:7
segments: for another gospel, which indeed is not another; only there are certain individuals who are troubling you, and desiring to pervert the gospel of Christ.

entries.title: Galatians 1:8
segments: But even though I myself or an angel from heaven were to preach any gospel other than that which I did preach to you, let him be accursed.

entries.title: Galatians 1:9
segments: I have said it before, and I now repeat it, if any one is preaching a gospel to you other than that which you have received, let him be accursed.

entries.title: Galatians 1:10
segments: Think you that I am now trying to conciliate men or God? Or am I "seeking to please men"? If I were still seeking to please men, I should not be a slave of Christ.

entries.title: Galatians 1:11
segments: For I would have you know, brothers, that the gospel I preach is not man-made;

entries.title: Galatians 1:12
segments: for neither did I myself receive it from man, nor by man was I taught it, but by a revelation [an apocalypse] of Jesus Christ.

entries.title: Galatians 1:13
segments: For you have heard of my former conduct in Judaism, how furiously I used to persecute the church of God, and how I kept seeking to root it out;

entries.title: Galatians 1:14
segments: and how in my zeal for Judaism I outstripped many of my own age and nation, in my special zeal for the traditions of my forefathers.

entries.title: Galatians 1:15
segments: But when God who had set me apart from my very birth,

entries.title: Galatians 1:16
segments: and had called me by his grace, was pleased to reveal his Son in me, so that I might preach his gospel among the Gentiles, without consulting a human being,

entries.title: Galatians 1:17
segments: or even going up to Jerusalem to see those who had been apostles before me, I went off at once to Arabia, and on my return came back to Damascus.

entries.title: Galatians 1:18
segments: Then three years later I went up to Jerusalem to get acquainted with Peter, and spent two weeks with him.

entries.title: Galatians 1:19
segments: I saw no other apostle except James, the Lord's brother.

entries.title: Galatians 1:20
segments: (In what I am now writing, I call God to witness that I am telling the truth.)

entries.title: Galatians 1:21
segments: Then I went into the districts of Syria and Cilicia.

entries.title: Galatians 1:22
segments: But to the churches of Christ in Judea I was personally unknown;

entries.title: Galatians 1:23
segments: only they used to hear it said, "He who was once persecuting us is now preaching the gospel of the very faith which he once tried to ruin."

entries.title: Galatians 1:24
segments: And they were giving glory to God on my account.
